pack.title: Synthetic Power Automate failure and recovery scenarios

scenarios.title: Complete a valid request
preconditions: The synthetic request passes schema and business validation.
The approved connection identity and downstream test fixture are available in the hypothetical target environment.

expected_results.observable_behavior: Exactly one logical order is recorded, the terminal outcome is completed, and the correlation ID is retained.

observed_results.detail: Offline scenario definition only; no flow was run.

duplicate_prevention_retry_recovery.duplicate_prevention: Persist a stable request key before side effects and return the prior outcome for a duplicate.
duplicate_prevention_retry_recovery.automatic_retry: None is needed for this case; any retry policy remains bounded.
duplicate_prevention_retry_recovery.human_authorized_replay: Only after checking the recorded outcome and obtaining required authorization.

evidence_to_collect: Synthetic trigger and validated input reference
Flow version and native run/action history if later executed
human_review_requirements: Review that the actual flow contract, side effects, identity, and success criteria match the approved design.

scenarios.title: Reject invalid or missing input before side effects
preconditions: Input validation is intended to precede all writes and notifications.
scenarios.injected_condition: Required quantity is missing and destination is empty.

expected_results.observable_behavior: A safe validation category is returned; no downstream write occurs and the operation is not reported as successful.

observed_results.detail: Offline scenario definition only; no flow was run.

duplicate_prevention_retry_recovery.duplicate_prevention: Do not create an idempotency success record or side effect for rejected input; corrections use an explicit new or authorized request.
duplicate_prevention_retry_recovery.automatic_retry: Do not retry unchanged invalid input.
duplicate_prevention_retry_recovery.human_authorized_replay: Corrected input may be submitted after review; check prior state first.
duplicate_prevention_retry_recovery.compensating_action: None because no side effect should have occurred.

evidence_to_collect: Assertion that downstream actions were not entered
human_review_requirements: Confirm required-field and business-rule validation is appropriate and does not expose submitted payload values.

scenarios.title: Handle a repeated delivery
preconditions: A prior delivery with the same stable business key has completed.
The idempotency record is available.
scenarios.injected_condition: The same event is delivered again after the first logical completion.

expected_results.observable_behavior: No second downstream business effect is created; duplicate detection and the original result are observable.

observed_results.detail: Offline scenario definition only; no flow was run.

duplicate_prevention_retry_recovery.duplicate_prevention: Use the stable key and persisted outcome; do not rely on trigger deduplication.
duplicate_prevention_retry_recovery.automatic_retry: Not applicable to an already completed request.
duplicate_prevention_retry_recovery.human_authorized_replay: Only after checking remote state and obtaining approval if replay changes state.
duplicate_prevention_retry_recovery.compensating_action: Do not automatically delete or reverse a suspected duplicate; reconcile with an owner.

evidence_to_collect: Original and repeated synthetic delivery references
Downstream state count before and after
human_review_requirements: Validate key scope, retention, race behavior, and duplicate response against the selected storage and connector.

scenarios.title: Serialize concurrent duplicate processing
preconditions: Two synthetic workers can receive the same idempotency key concurrently.
The target concurrency and idempotency design is documented.
scenarios.injected_condition: Two deliveries with the same key arrive before either worker has completed.

expected_results.observable_behavior: At most one logical side effect is recorded; any lock conflict, wait, or ambiguous result remains visible and does not imply exactly-once platform delivery.

observed_results.detail: Offline scenario definition only; no flow was run.

duplicate_prevention_retry_recovery.duplicate_prevention: Use an atomic claim/unique constraint or a validated concurrency control; verify races under the actual storage semantics.
duplicate_prevention_retry_recovery.automatic_retry: Only bounded retry of a safe claim operation, if supported and validated.
duplicate_prevention_retry_recovery.human_authorized_replay: Reconcile uncertain claims and downstream state before authorized replay.

evidence_to_collect: Both synthetic run IDs and timestamps
Concurrency configuration and idempotency claim outcomes
human_review_requirements: Confirm actual connector/storage atomicity and flow concurrency semantics; do not infer them from this scenario.

scenarios.title: Stop dependent work on authentication failure
preconditions: An approved logical connection is configured in the hypothetical environment.
scenarios.injected_condition: The synthetic connector action returns an authentication failure.

expected_results.observable_behavior: Dependent writes stop, original failure is preserved, an owner is notified safely, and no alternate identity is silently used.

observed_results.detail: Offline scenario definition only; no flow was run.

duplicate_prevention_retry_recovery.duplicate_prevention: Retain the request key and inspect for prior side effects before resumption.
duplicate_prevention_retry_recovery.automatic_retry: No unbounded authentication retry; credential repair requires owner action.
duplicate_prevention_retry_recovery.human_authorized_replay: After approved identity repair and prior-state check.
duplicate_prevention_retry_recovery.compensating_action: None unless an independently reviewed recovery plan requires it.

evidence_to_collect: Logical connection name and configured identity evidence
human_review_requirements: Connection owner reviews access restoration and least privilege; verify no silent identity switch.

scenarios.title: Hold for reconciliation after an uncertain write timeout
preconditions: A downstream write may commit even if its response is delayed or lost.
A safe status lookup or reconciliation path is identified, or the question is explicitly unresolved.
scenarios.injected_condition: The downstream write response times out after submission; completion is unknown.

expected_results.observable_behavior: The operation remains failed or pending reconciliation, not successful; no blind replay occurs while the remote outcome is unknown.

observed_results.detail: Offline scenario definition only; no flow was run.

duplicate_prevention_retry_recovery.duplicate_prevention: Keep the idempotency key and query/reconcile the downstream state if a validated read is available.
duplicate_prevention_retry_recovery.automatic_retry: Do not automatically retry an uncertain non-idempotent write.
duplicate_prevention_retry_recovery.human_authorized_replay: Only after outcome is known or a validated idempotent operation is confirmed and authorized.
duplicate_prevention_retry_recovery.compensating_action: Do not compensate automatically while completion is uncertain.

human_review_requirements: Owner confirms safe read/reconciliation method and approves any replay or compensation.

scenarios.title: Retry a throttled safe operation within a bound
preconditions: The operation is known to be safe to repeat or idempotent.
A finite retry count and delay policy are defined for the actual connector.
scenarios.injected_condition: The synthetic action returns a throttling response for two attempts, then succeeds.

expected_results.state_transition: attempt_1_throttled -> bounded_wait -> attempt_2_throttled -> bounded_wait -> attempt_3_succeeded -> completed
expected_results.observable_behavior: Attempts and delays remain within the configured bound; success is recorded only after the action succeeds.

observed_results.detail: Offline scenario definition only; no flow was run.

duplicate_prevention_retry_recovery.duplicate_prevention: Preserve the same idempotency key across attempts.
duplicate_prevention_retry_recovery.automatic_retry: Bounded retry only if connector support, response handling, and operation safety are verified; no guarantee is assumed here.
duplicate_prevention_retry_recovery.human_authorized_replay: After exhaustion, replay only after review and outcome check.

evidence_to_collect: Configured policy and actual connector retry behavior
Attempt count and sanitized response categories
human_review_requirements: Verify connector-specific retry behavior, delay limits, and throttling policy in the target environment.

scenarios.title: Preserve failure after bounded retries are exhausted
preconditions: A finite retry policy is configured for a safe repeatable operation.
scenarios.injected_condition: The synthetic action continues returning a transient failure through the final allowed attempt.

expected_results.observable_behavior: No further automatic attempts occur, the business result remains failed, and sanitized support details include a correlation reference.

observed_results.detail: Offline scenario definition only; no flow was run.

duplicate_prevention_retry_recovery.duplicate_prevention: Do not create a success marker; preserve request key and action history.
duplicate_prevention_retry_recovery.automatic_retry: Stop at the configured finite bound.
duplicate_prevention_retry_recovery.human_authorized_replay: Owner checks side effects and authorizes any later replay.
duplicate_prevention_retry_recovery.compensating_action: Only a separately approved recovery plan may compensate.

evidence_to_collect: All attempt outcomes and final run status
human_review_requirements: Review failure classification and choose repair, reconciliation, or authorized replay.

scenarios.title: Recover explicitly from a partial operation
preconditions: A synthetic operation has at least two ordered effects.
Recovery options and approval authority are documented before execution.
scenarios.injected_condition: The reservation succeeds but the subsequent ledger write fails.

expected_results.state_transition: started -> reservation_completed -> ledger_write_failed -> partial_failed -> human_reconciled -> recovered_or_compensated
expected_results.observable_behavior: The operation is not labeled successful; completed effects are retained and recovery outcome is recorded distinctly.

observed_results.detail: Offline scenario definition only; no flow was run.

duplicate_prevention_retry_recovery.duplicate_prevention: Mark the incomplete operation and prevent an unreviewed duplicate from repeating the completed reservation.
duplicate_prevention_retry_recovery.automatic_retry: Only retry the failed step if its safety and prior outcome are known.
duplicate_prevention_retry_recovery.human_authorized_replay: Owner explicitly authorizes a scoped replay after state reconciliation.
duplicate_prevention_retry_recovery.compensating_action: Compensation is a separate, reviewed action; never automatically destructive.

evidence_to_collect: Reconciliation of completed and pending effects
human_review_requirements: Named owner chooses replay, compensation, or manual reconciliation and reviews the final state.

scenarios.title: Continue the gated action after approval
preconditions: The request is valid and a synthetic approval is pending.
The approver is authorized for this hypothetical gate.
scenarios.injected_condition: The synthetic approver approves before the configured expiry.

expected_results.observable_behavior: Only the approved gated action proceeds; the decision, approver reference, and terminal status are auditable.

observed_results.detail: Offline scenario definition only; no flow was run.

duplicate_prevention_retry_recovery.duplicate_prevention: Associate the approval with one request and consume the decision once.
duplicate_prevention_retry_recovery.automatic_retry: Do not resubmit approval automatically after an ambiguous response.
duplicate_prevention_retry_recovery.human_authorized_replay: A new approval or replay requires owner review and prior-state check.
duplicate_prevention_retry_recovery.compensating_action: None unless the gated action partially fails; then use the separate recovery case.

evidence_to_collect: Sanitized approval decision and approver reference
Gated action result and terminal state
human_review_requirements: Confirm approver authority, gate scope, and evidence retention.

scenarios.title: Stop the gated action after rejection
preconditions: A valid synthetic request is pending approval.
scenarios.injected_condition: The synthetic approver rejects the request.

expected_results.observable_behavior: No gated side effect occurs; rejection is a terminal business outcome, not a successful fulfillment.

observed_results.detail: Offline scenario definition only; no flow was run.

duplicate_prevention_retry_recovery.duplicate_prevention: Record the terminal decision against the request; do not re-trigger the gated action.
duplicate_prevention_retry_recovery.automatic_retry: Do not retry a rejected decision.
duplicate_prevention_retry_recovery.human_authorized_replay: A changed request follows the approved resubmission process.
duplicate_prevention_retry_recovery.compensating_action: None because the gated action did not run.

evidence_to_collect: Assertion that gated action was skipped
human_review_requirements: Review rejection handling and any permitted resubmission route.

scenarios.title: Reassign approval without bypassing the gate
preconditions: A synthetic approval is pending and an authorized reassignment path exists.
scenarios.injected_condition: The initial synthetic approver reassigns the pending request.

expected_results.observable_behavior: The gated action remains blocked until a valid terminal decision by the authorized successor.

observed_results.detail: Offline scenario definition only; no flow was run.

duplicate_prevention_retry_recovery.duplicate_prevention: Keep one request/approval identity through reassignment; prevent parallel active decisions unless design explicitly permits them.
duplicate_prevention_retry_recovery.automatic_retry: Do not retry ambiguous reassignment automatically.
duplicate_prevention_retry_recovery.human_authorized_replay: Owner verifies current assignment before manual resend.
duplicate_prevention_retry_recovery.compensating_action: None; reassignment is not authorization to execute.

evidence_to_collect: Assignment change event and approver references
human_review_requirements: Validate successor authority and the platform's reassignment behavior.

scenarios.title: Close an expired approval without executing
preconditions: A synthetic approval is pending with an explicitly defined expiry policy.
scenarios.injected_condition: The approval deadline elapses without a decision.

expected_results.observable_behavior: The gated action does not run; expiry is observable and routed according to the documented owner policy.

observed_results.detail: Offline scenario definition only; no flow was run.

duplicate_prevention_retry_recovery.duplicate_prevention: Keep the expired approval terminal and do not accept stale decisions unless actual platform policy allows them.
duplicate_prevention_retry_recovery.automatic_retry: Do not extend or resend approval implicitly.
duplicate_prevention_retry_recovery.human_authorized_replay: Owner may initiate a new approval after checking request validity.
duplicate_prevention_retry_recovery.compensating_action: None because gated action did not execute.

evidence_to_collect: Assertion gated action did not run
Owner escalation result and correlation reference
human_review_requirements: Confirm expiry policy, timezone behavior, and permissible resubmission with the platform owner.

scenarios.title: Preserve the approved service identity across ownership change
preconditions: A named owner and logical service identity are approved.
A synthetic ownership transition is planned.
scenarios.injected_condition: The primary owner becomes unavailable during the synthetic continuity check.

expected_results.observable_behavior: The approved logical identity and least-privilege access remain explicit; if continuity cannot be verified, dependent processing is blocked and escalated.

observed_results.detail: Offline scenario definition only; no flow was run.

duplicate_prevention_retry_recovery.duplicate_prevention: Do not switch to an unapproved personal identity or replay pending writes during handoff.
duplicate_prevention_retry_recovery.human_authorized_replay: Resume after an authorized successor verifies access and pending state.

evidence_to_collect: Logical connection reference and identity review
Blocked/resumed run evidence if later executed
human_review_requirements: Platform and security owners confirm connection ownership, least privilege, licensing, and successor access.

scenarios.title: Keep the business failure when support notification fails
preconditions: A business action has failed and a support notification is attempted in Catch.
scenarios.injected_condition: The synthetic support notification action also fails.

expected_results.observable_behavior: Neither notification success nor failure changes the business result; an alternate escalation path is identified when available.

observed_results.detail: Offline scenario definition only; no flow was run.

duplicate_prevention_retry_recovery.duplicate_prevention: Do not rerun the business action merely because its notification failed.
duplicate_prevention_retry_recovery.automatic_retry: Only bounded notification retry if safe and configured; business failure remains.
duplicate_prevention_retry_recovery.human_authorized_replay: Business replay requires its own prior-state check and authorization.
duplicate_prevention_retry_recovery.compensating_action: No business compensation for notification failure.

human_review_requirements: Confirm a support path exists for notification failure and that no action can convert failure to success.

scenarios.title: Log correlation safely without sensitive payloads
preconditions: A synthetic request has a correlation ID and a safe logging allowlist.
scenarios.injected_condition: A downstream failure produces diagnostic context that includes a synthetic sensitive-field marker.

expected_results.observable_behavior: Logs contain the correlation ID, safe category, action reference, and outcome; the payload marker, credentials, and sensitive values are absent.

observed_results.detail: Offline scenario definition only; no flow was run.

duplicate_prevention_retry_recovery.duplicate_prevention: Use correlation and idempotency references for diagnosis without logging complete payloads.
duplicate_prevention_retry_recovery.automatic_retry: Logging failure does not trigger business action retry.
duplicate_prevention_retry_recovery.human_authorized_replay: Replay follows the separate approved recovery path.

evidence_to_collect: Sanitized log sample and field allowlist
Redaction assertion for marker and sensitive fields
human_review_requirements: Privacy/security reviewer verifies actual log sinks, retention, access, and redaction behavior.
